2607.15883.title: Perceived AGI: Believability as Dimensional Completeness, Not Capability
2607.15883.paper_summary: Large language models are broadly capable, yet in sustained one-to-one conversation they still read as flat: competent, responsive, and somehow not quite the presence of a mind. We hypothesize that a central missing ingredient is not more capability but dimensional completeness. We propose that the believability of an artificial interlocutor -- the degree to which a user attributes an inner life to it, which we call perceived mind -- is governed by whether the agent expresses a small set of first-person stances that humans use as evidence of mind, and that this is separable from task intelligence. We name four such dimensions -- time, truth, entropy, and love -- each defined as a behavioral stance rather than a benchmark competency, each with a human analog and a concrete emulation path; the time dimension already has an author-reported prototype. We identify an observable behavior layer -- initiative (unprompted action) and cadence (the shape and timing of turns) -- through which the stances surface in conversation, both partially realized as deployed features in a production companion application. We state six falsifiable predictions that a later pre-registered study will test, separating those that are pre-registrable now from those that remain conjectures pending operationalization. This is a conceptual framework: it reports no human-subjects data, and its central comparative claims are predictions, not findings. Throughout we hold a firm boundary -- the object is inferrable interiority, not interiority; this is perception engineering, not a theory of machine consciousness -- and we treat the resulting attachment and manipulation risks as load-bearing rather than incidental.
2607.15883.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型具有廣泛的能力，但在持續的一對一對話中，它們仍然顯得平淡：能幹、反應靈敏，卻在某種程度上缺乏心智的存在。我們假設，一個中心缺失的成分不是更多的能力，而是維度的完整性。我們提出，人工對話者的可信度——用戶對其內心生活的歸因程度，我們稱之為感知心智——取決於該代理是否表達一小組人類用作心智證據的第一人稱立場，而這與任務智能是可分的。我們命名了四個這樣的維度——時間、真實、熵和愛——每個維度都被定義為一種行為立場，而不是基準能力，每個維度都有一個人類類比和具體的模擬路徑；時間維度已經有作者報告的原型。我們確定了一個可觀察的行為層——主動性（未提示的行動）和節奏（回合的形狀和時機）——通過這些立場在對話中顯現，部分實現為生產伴侶應用中的部署特徵。我們陳述了六個可證偽的預測，稍後的預註冊研究將對其進行測試，將現在可預註冊的與仍然待操作化的猜想分開。這是一個概念框架：它不報告任何人類受試者數據，其中心比較主張是預測，而不是發現。在整個過程中，我們保持明確的界限——對象是可推斷的內在性，而不是內在性；這是感知工程，而不是機器意識的理論——我們將由此產生的依附和操控風險視為承載性風險，而非偶然風險。
2607.15883.author: Sebastian Cochinescu et.al.
